verdict.rationale: Mercury Books documents P&L, cash flow and balance sheet reports, accrual accounting, and bill pay with approvals and duplicate detection. Nothing in the evidence mentions an accounts payable aging report, per-vendor balances, or point-in-time (as-of date) AP views. A balance sheet and bill-pay workflow are adjacent features, not the AP aging and vendor-balance capability the story asks for, so this applicable accounting axis gets no credit.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can see accounts payable aging and vendor balances at any point in time
